 The Reader: A new review source for book lovers
 Most newspapers and wire services have closed the book on sections devoted to book reviews. But Washington Monthly's new online resource, The Reader (co-founded by bestselling author Jonathan Alter), offers book reviews, essays, and recommendations by some of the world's top writers. Jane Pauley reports.
